cc:Work.dc:title: Jetson Thor · Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4
cc:Work.dc:description: Stock SGLang, stock vLLM, TensorRT Edge-LLM and the add-on on one Jetson Thor for NVFP4. The AX tree leads code and math and ties Edge-LLM DDTree 32 on chat.
